summary: IntervueAI is a voice-first mock interview studio that pairs scripted or REST-backed prompts with live transcripts, heuristics, and analytics inside a cinematic Ops Deck dashboard.
stack: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + React Query + Web Speech/Web Audio APIs on the frontend, optional Express REST shim + MSW for mocking, Vitest/RTL for testing.

P0.issue: AppShell passes `visibleSections`/`header` props into InterviewConfigPanel but the component interface ignores them, causing TypeScript errors and preventing dynamic panel layouts.
Sidebar nav + DNA buttons act as toggles but expose no `aria-pressed`/`aria-current`, so screen readers cannot tell which mode is active.
P0.impact: WCAG 4.1.2 failure; keyboard users lose state.

P0.issue: SessionViewerModal lacks `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, escape handling, and focus trap, so focus can fall behind the overlay.
P0.fix_snippet:
```tsx
{/* modal content */}
```

P0.issue: TranscriptList renders plain divs without `role="log"` or `aria-live`, so assistive tech never hears new utterances.
MicGateIndicator returns `null` when the mic is idle, giving no persistent status text; SR users cannot tell whether capture is paused.
P0.impact: No alternative cue for mic state.

P1.issue: Noise overlay + radial gradients render on every route and never respect `prefers-reduced-motion` beyond base CSS, inflating paint work.
P1.impact: Unnecessary GPU load on low-power devices.

P1.issue: HistoryPanel delete button relies on `confirm()` without describing the session being removed.
AnalyticsPanel sparkline SVG lacks `aria-label` or descriptive text.

P2.issue: All interview hooks load eagerly; `RestLLMAdapter` and MSW support could be code-split so the default local adapter shaves bundle size.
Index.css ships critical background styles + global font but nothing inlined into `<head>` yet.
P2.impact: Flash of unstyled gradient on cold loads.

P2.issue: Footer contact links do not expose analytics hooks or downloadable contact card.
